reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: What is the total value of 1 ₱50 bill, 1 ₱5 coin, and 1 ₱1 coin?
What is the total value of 1 ₱10 coin and 1 ₱1 coin?
Compare the numbers: 307 ___ 270. Which sign is correct: >, <, or =?
Compare the numbers: 92 ___ 930. Which sign is correct: >, <, or =?
What is the total value of 2 ₱20 bills and 1 ₱5 coin?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The verb is 'compare the values of different denominations', but seeds 42, 43 and 46 ask for totals (50 + 5 + 1 = 56, 10 + 1 = 11, 20 + 20 + 5 = 45) and seeds 44/45 compare bare numerals. No sample ever sets two money amounts side by side to be compared.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: None of the expected comparisons appear: coin against coin, bill against bill, coin against bill, or equal-value sets such as five 20-peso coins against one 100-peso bill. The '=' relation shows up only as a distractor in seeds 44 and 45.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: 'Compare the numbers: 92 ___ 930. Which sign is correct: >, <, or =?' is readable at Grade 2 Quarter 2 and the >, <, = symbol set is age-appropriate, even though the content it is applied to is the wrong content for this node.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Three of the five stems (seeds 42, 43, 46) are word-for-word the same items served under mat_g2_na_q2_0, so this node has no distinct variant pool of its own, and no money-comparison context of any kind is offered.

competency_alignment.rationale: The only genuine difficulty axis present is place-value comparison of abstract numerals (307 versus 270, 92 versus 930), which develops a different competency and leaves comparison of peso denominations at zero exposure across all five seeds.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The comparison numerals (92 to 930) sit inside 1000 and the money totals (11 to 56 pesos) sit far below it, so nothing in the sample approaches or tests the 1000-peso boundary the competency explicitly names.
